column1: # Bash definition rule. Recorded: functions in every spelling (name() {}, function name {},
# function name() {}, name() ( ... )), nested ones and those inside if included (function);
# aliases anywhere (function); variables assigned at the top level of the file: NAME=value,
# export NAME=value, declare/typeset [flags] NAME[=value] (variable), and readonly NAME=value and
# declare/typeset -r (constant). Each name of a multi-assignment line is its own symbol, and a name
# assigned twice at top level is recorded at each assignment.
# An append (NAME+=value, NAME+=(...)) is not an assignment of its own and is not recorded.
# Not recorded: local, anything assigned inside a function, loop, case or if, a bare "export NAME",
# "export -f", env prefixes (FOO=1 cmd), text inside here-documents and strings.
